children: DataMeds AI confirmed stockholders’ equity exceeds $2,500,000 after settling litigation, repurchasing shares and issuing stock for a license.
Paid $450,000 under settlement: $350,000 to repurchase and extinguish 364,099 shares, $100,000 to settle MIPA-related claims.
Settlement extinguished approximately $19 million of liabilities on the consolidated balance sheet, improving equity position.
Entered license agreement with REBOOT and issued 666,667 shares of common stock as consideration for a care management platform.
As of Oct 13, 2026, stockholders’ equity is confirmed to be greater than $2,500,000 following these transactions.
